knownIssues.issue: ICCU (Integrated Charging Control Unit) thermal/fuse failure. Symptoms: audible pop from rear, 'Check electric vehicle system' warning, immediate limp mode, total 12V drain, vehicle becomes undriveable and unable to AC-charge.
knownIssues.resolution: Verify VIN at Kia Canada recall lookup. Demand written confirmation that ICCU software flash + physical inspection have been completed before contracting. P0D5C diagnostic code triggers full module replacement.

knownIssues.resolution: Verify VIN at Hyundai Canada recall lookup. Get written campaign-completion paperwork before delivery.
